title: Nuluno Access Community 0.1.0-alpha.2 preview
notes:
Apache-2.0 Nuluno Access Community 0.1.0-alpha.2 prerelease.

Exact source: 5d1c9f0da2e4b8802e4c86c065849b12b1c5dc3e. Reviewed readiness run 43668999182 and immutable artifact 14142713262. Four exact assets only: npm-format archive, source ZIP, release manifest and SHA256SUMS.

New public-status notebook saves real bounded public text, reuses its original task and receipt through MCP and REST SDK after process replacement, revokes the original key, and records exit 3 on a later fresh-process denial. The exact-source actual Linux public-status run is https://github.com/wangthewhale/nuluno-access-community/actions/runs/43669105138 . Core CI booted a real Linux container and preserved the same volume and revocation through two restarts.

The SDK and stdio bridge identify the actual Community version. Confirmed Cloudflare 1010 and recognized no-auth-challenge block pages are classified as transport failures without asking for unrelated authorization. Invalid, revoked and out-of-scope keys remain denied. No automatic POST retry, key renewal or grant expansion was added.

This is a self-hosted scoped authorization core and existing-account Mastodon adapter. Gmail verification/signup and Threads implementations are not included. Commercial extension 0.1.0-alpha.1 retains its exact alpha.1 Community peer; this alpha.2 release does not alter that paid pair or claim its compatibility. Private Gmail-to-publication acceptance, outside human adoption, sales lift and lower complete costs are unverified. Consent, CAPTCHA and identity checks are not bypassed. Unknown costs remain unknown. No npm registry publication, permanent hosted service or signed-attestation claim.
